title: Base change of a quotient ring: B ⊗_A (A/I) ≅ B/IB
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal; write $IB$ for the ideal of $B$ generated by the image of $I$. Then there is an isomorphism of $B$-algebras $B/IB\xrightarrow{\sim}B\otimes_A(A/I)$, $b\bmod IB\mapsto b\otimes1$, with inverse $b\otimes(a\bmod I)\mapsto ab\bmod IB$. In particular, if $I$ is generated by $f_1,\dots,f_m$, then $B\otimes_A(A/I)\cong B/(\bar f_1,\dots,\bar f_m)$ with $\bar f_j$ the image of $f_j$ in $B$.
